note: Approved narration, word for word (text). 'say' is only what the voice engine reads: 'Guhit' is respelled so it is said goo-HEET. One audio file per id.

lines.text: What if every drawing had a friend inside?
Guhit cuts it out, and brings it to life.
lines.say: Goo-heet cuts it out, and brings it to life.

lines.text: It moves like what it is.
It even guesses what you drew.
Hold to talk, and your friend talks back.
All the AI runs right here, on the device.
Nothing your child draws or says ever leaves it.
Every drawing has a friend inside.
